note: Free motion data we can study from or use. 'ship' says whether clips may go into the game Abbie's World ships. Licences change: check the source before shipping. Never train a model on Mixamo files.

sources.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
sources.size: about 2,600 takes from 144 subjects (walks, runs, sports, dance, everyday actions)
sources.licence: free for all uses, including commercial; a credit line is requested

sources.name: Adobe Mixamo
sources.size: thousands of keyed and captured clips with auto-rigging
sources.licence: royalty-free in games and films, no credit needed; raw files may not be redistributed (no asset packs, no public repo copies); may not be used to train machine-learning models
sources.ship_note: only baked into the game's own models, never as loose files in the public repo

sources.name: 100STYLE (Mason, Starke and Komura, 2022)
sources.size: over 4 million frames: 100 walking and running styles, each forward, backward, sideways, idle and turning
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 per the authors' release; confirm on the dataset page before shipping

sources.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library
sources.size: 120+ game animations on a universal humanoid rig (most of the standard pack is free)

sources.name: Ubisoft La Forge Animation Dataset (LAFAN1)
sources.size: 77 sequences, 5 subjects, about 4.6 hours at 30 fps (walks, runs, obstacles, dance, fall and get up)
sources.ship_note: study only: watch it, measure timing and weight, never ship or edit the clips

sources.name: Bandai Namco Research Motion Dataset
sources.size: about 3,000 moves: dataset 1 has 17 contents (daily life, fighting, dance) in 15 styles such as active, tired and happy; dataset 2 is locomotion and hand actions in 7 styles
sources.ship_note: study only while Abbie's World charges money; great for learning how one action changes with mood
